title: マイルCSの後に・風はここから

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Sick running, Rubae!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: And you as well.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Today's been so hype! I mean, sheesh! Were the good vibes vibin' or what?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Like, did you see Bree-Z? She was like WHOOOSH! And then she was all ZOOOM!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Seriously, that was a BLAST!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr…

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: …Quite the troublesome individual.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Pant… Puff…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (I drew everything in, and…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Today, I became the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But there's more I can be.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I will continue to hone my skills, and I will become sharper, stronger, fiercer…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Until the autumn shield is mine as promised.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Oh?

text_block_list.name: Zephyr Fans
text_block_list.text: Zephyr! Yamanin Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Zephyr Fans
text_block_list.text: Your running today was innncredible! You got us all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Zephyr Fans
text_block_list.text: Show us your wind and fighting spirit in your next race, too!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my… That banner reads, "Zephyr Spirit."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Hehehe… Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (How pleasant! I'm absolutely exhausted… but I feel a benison breeze at my back, lifting the weight from my body and carrying me forward!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'll breathe in your support as well. I'll draw it into myself… and look—I've become a greater wind yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race and winning concert, once the crowds have left, and only the hush of night remains…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Walking amidst the quiet grandstand of Kyoto Racecourse, Yamanin Zephyr suddenly stops in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: For me, this is where the wind was born…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It all started here. Here, I encountered my wind of inspiration, the Mile Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'd like my next goal to be the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: More precisely… to come first. Total victory in the Yasuda Kinen.
choice_data_list: All right. Then, at long last…
All right. Then, at long last…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's begin.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Until the summer winds come dancing in, I will train even harder!
